sources.density_kg_m3: judgment: a compact, poorly sorted mud-matrix rock with dense clasts; slightly above conglomerate; rounded to 10 kg/m³; set with the glacial landforms (2026-09-30), between conglomerate and mudstone
sources.erodibility: judgment, relative to granite: strength set by the indurated mud matrix; the clasts of every size resist; bedrock ranked by rock strength: river incision scales roughly with tensile strength^-2 (Sklar & Dietrich 2001, Geology 29(12):1087–1090) and lithologic K contrasts span orders of magnitude (Stock & Montgomery 1999, JGR 104(B3):4983–4993); the strength-based contrast is compressed to its square root, so bedrock spans about 0.3–4; set with the glacial landforms (2026-09-30), between conglomerate and mudstone
sources.diffusivity: judgment, relative to granite: massive, unbedded rock that sheds a bouldery, clayey regolith; hillslope transport coefficient D of Roering, Kirchner & Dietrich 1999 (WRR 35(3):853–870), used as a linear creep multiplier and scaled by how readily the rock makes mobile soil (soil production function, Heimsath et al. 1997, Nature 388:358–361): loose and friable classes 2–5, soft sedimentary 1.2–2, crystalline 0.5–1; set with the glacial landforms (2026-09-30), between conglomerate and mudstone
sources.vanilla_fallback: last fallback entry (MIC rock-tag README, Fallbacks table)
sources.stone_use: judgment (P1-28, Ben's hardness tiers 2026-10-01): lithified till, well cemented and clast-rich; its stand-in is cobbled deepslate, which vanilla already counts

notes: Diamictite and tillite: lithified till and glaciomarine diamict, clasts of every size floating in a mud matrix (the Neoproterozoic snowball diamictites, the Dwyka Group). Its muddy matrix takes the pelitic metamorphic path. Stand-in: cobbled deepslate, a dark matrix with lighter fragments of mixed size and shape, unlike conglomerate's clast-supported cobblestone.
